# Project guidance

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `ARCHITECTURE.md`.

- Rust 1.99+, FFmpeg/FFprobe, yt-dlp; preserve the thirty visual designs.
- Keep credentials, generated media and binaries out of Git and Docker contexts.
- Preserve S3 schemas, Tomsk scheduling intervals, silent snippet posts, and
  author/chat restrictions. Persist claims before publication to prevent duplicates.
- Keep Go build caches outside the repository when checking historical code.
